ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖۤ اَنْ اَنْذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ یَّاْتِیَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: We sent Noah to his people (and directed him): “Warn your people before a grievous chastisement comes upon them.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: Noah said: “My people, I have certainly been sent as a clear warner to you,

ayahs.arabicText: اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اتَّقُوْهُ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: that you serve Allah and fear Him, and follow me;

ayahs.arabicText: یَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِّنْ ذُنُوْبِكُمْ وَ یُؤَخِّرْكُمْ اِلٰۤى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى١ؕ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَآءَ لَا یُؤَخَّرُ١ۘ لَوْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He will forgive your sins and will grant you respite until an appointed term. Indeed when Allah's appointed term comes, it cannot be deferred; if you only knew!”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِیْ لَیْلًا وَّ نَهَارًاۙ
ayahs.translation: He said: “My Lord, I called my people by night and by day,

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمْ یَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِیْۤ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
ayahs.translation: but the more I called, the farther they fled.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنِّیْ كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوْۤا اَصَابِعَهُمْ فِیْۤ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَ اسْتَغْشَوْا ثِیَابَهُمْ وَ اَصَرُّوْا وَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًاۚ
ayahs.translation: And every time I called them so that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped up their faces with their garments and obstinately clung to their attitude, and waxed very proud.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اِنِّیْ دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Then I summoned them openly,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اِنِّیْۤ اَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَ اَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ اِسْرَارًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and preached to them in public, and also addressed them in secret.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوْا رَبَّكُمْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًاۙ
ayahs.translation: I said to them: “Ask forgiveness from your Lord; surely He is Most Forgiving.

ayahs.arabicText: یُّرْسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَیْكُمْ مِّدْرَارًاۙ
ayahs.translation: He will shower upon you torrents from heaven,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ یُمْدِدْكُمْ بِاَمْوَالٍ وَّ بَنِیْنَ وَ یَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ یَجْعَلْ لَّكُمْ اَنْهٰرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: and will provide you with wealth and children, and will bestow upon you gardens and rivers.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًاۚ
ayahs.translation: What is amiss with you that you do not look forward to the majesty of Allah

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ اَطْوَارًا
ayahs.translation: when He has created you in stages?

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَیْفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens, one upon the other,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ جَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِیْهِنَّ نُوْرًا وَّ جَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
ayahs.translation: and has placed the moon in them as a light, and the sun as a radiant lamp?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اللّٰهُ اَنْۢبَتَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ نَبَاتًاۙ
ayahs.translation: And Allah has caused you to grow out of the earth so wondrously,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ یُعِیْدُكُمْ فِیْهَا وَ یُخْرِجُكُمْ اِخْرَاجًا
ayahs.translation: and He will later cause you to return to it and will then again bring you out of it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ بِسَاطًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Allah has made the earth a wide expanse for you

ayahs.arabicText: لِّتَسْلُكُوْا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: so that you may tread its spacious paths.”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ نُوْحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِیْ وَ اتَّبَعُوْا مَنْ لَّمْ یَزِدْهُ مَالُهٗ وَ وَلَدُهٗۤ اِلَّا خَسَارًاۚ
ayahs.translation: Noah said: “My Lord, they did not pay heed to what I said, and followed those (nobles) whose possession of wealth and children has led them to an even greater loss.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَكَرُوْا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًاۚ
ayahs.translation: They contrived a plot of great magnitude.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمْ وَ لَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّ لَا سُوَاعًا١ۙ۬ وَّ لَا یَغُوْثَ وَ یَعُوْقَ وَ نَسْرًاۚ
ayahs.translation: They said: “Do not abandon your deities; do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, nor Yauq, nor Nasr.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَدْ اَضَلُّوْا كَثِیْرًا١ۚ۬ وَ لَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلًا
ayahs.translation: They have misled many. So do not enable these evildoers to increase in anything except straying (from the Right Way).”

ayahs.arabicText: مِمَّا خَطِیْٓئٰتِهِمْ اُغْرِقُوْا فَاُدْخِلُوْا نَارًا١ۙ۬ فَلَمْ یَجِدُوْا لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَنْصَارًا
ayahs.translation: And so they were drowned on account of their sins, and then cast into the Fire, and did not find any other than Allah, to come forth to their help.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ نُوْحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ دَیَّارًا
ayahs.translation: Noah said: “My Lord, do not leave out of these unbelievers even a single dweller on earth,

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكَ اِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ یُضِلُّوْا عِبَادَكَ وَ لَا یَلِدُوْۤا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
ayahs.translation: for certainly if You should leave them (alive), they will mislead Your servants, and will beget none but sinners and utter unbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِیْ وَ لِوَالِدَیَّ وَ لِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَیْتِیَ مُؤْمِنًا وَّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ١ؕ وَ لَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and forgive all believers, both men and women, and do not increase the wrong-doers in anything except perdition.”
